name: Odysseus
description: Self-hosted AI workspace with chat, agents and deep research

paths.name: Data
paths.description: odysseus/ (chats, documents, settings, model downloads), chromadb/ (memory vectors), searxng/ (search settings) and state/secrets.env. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Odysseus web UI and API, published on host as 6753

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The admin's password, at least 8 characters. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used to make the admin on first start.
